name: Wizard's Tower
author: Brickworks
about: A black tower of four clustered piers, banded in grey and crowned with curved horns, with furnished rooms inside. Claude designed it from one paragraph; the grey wizard and the white wizard stand at the top, and two tower guards keep the stair.
note: Built as one piece in steps a person can follow: its figures hold together, its horns stand on turntables, and every part is made in its colour.

name: A castle, from one sentence
author: Brickworks
about: A stone castle with four corner towers, a gatehouse and a paved courtyard, ringed by a moat. Claude designed it from a single sentence, as ten sub-assemblies you can build one at a time.
note: Built as one piece now: its ground course is tied by a course below, and no detail runs into what it sits by.

name: A barn owl
author: Brickworks
about: A barn owl perched on a post, its white face and tan wings shaped in layers of bricks and slopes, on a small base with leaves, flowers and a mouse. Designed by Claude.
note: Built as one piece in steps a person can follow: a course of long plates ties the base together, the mouse sits on two studs, and every part is made in its colour.

name: A three-core heavy-lift rocket
author: Brickworks
about: A heavy-lift rocket of three cores side by side on its launch mount, with the strongback tower beside it and a pad technician for scale. Designed by Claude.
note: Built as one piece in steps a person can follow: the nose sits on a round plate that holds it, and the pad's dishes stand on studs.

name: A small modular corner shop
author: Brickworks
about: A corner building with a shop under a striped awning, a flat above and a cornice round the roof, on its own stretch of pavement. Designed by Claude, with a shopkeeper, a customer, a tenant and a passer-by.
note: Built as one piece in steps a person can follow: the building sits on the baseplate's studs, the figures stand on studs, and every part is made in its colour.

name: A sports car, and its driver
author: Brickworks
about: A red sports car with white racing stripes and a black rear wing, and beside it its driver with a trophy and a nameplate. Designed by Claude.
note: Built as one piece in steps a person can follow: the fenders sit on the chassis a plate higher, and the driver's gold trophy stands at their feet.

name: Orrery of the Sun and eight planets
author: Brickworks
about: A working orrery: one crank turns all eight planets round the Sun, each through a gear train of its own, and every planet's year comes within 0.35% of NASA's. A Claude session built it in Brickworks, finding each train with the app's gear ratio search.
note: Built in steps a person can follow: the spine goes in between the planets, and the pillar tops let the axles through.

name: A treehouse in an old oak
author: Brickworks
about: A big old oak with a sculpted trunk and a leafy canopy, carrying two wooden huts at different heights joined by a rope bridge, with a ladder, a slide, a swing, a pulley and bucket and a lookout with a telescope and flag; a family of five plays among the roots and flowers. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A vintage tractor and hay trailer
author: Brickworks
about: A green farm tractor with red wheels, a grille and headlamps, gauges and a tall exhaust, its farmer at the wheel, towing a two-wheeled trailer of hay bales with a pitchfork. Every axle turns and the trailer swings on a tow ball. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A red fox on a mossy log
author: Brickworks
about: A red fox sitting up on a mossy log: its body sculpted in orange with a white chest and muzzle, black socks and a bushy white-tipped tail, on a grassy base with toadstools, fallen leaves and a stick. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A moon rover and its crew
author: Brickworks
about: A six-wheeled moon rover in white and grey on rocker suspension, with a pressurised cab, a dish antenna, a solar panel and a robot arm with a scoop; one astronaut drives and one plants a flag, among craters, rocks and ice crystals. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A working windmill
author: Brickworks
about: An eight-sided smock mill in dark tan and reddish brown on a white base, with a cap and four lattice sails: turn the crank at the back and the sails turn through a gear train. The miller stands at the door with a sack of flour, beside his cart. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A village bakery
author: Brickworks
about: A two-storey village bakery: tan brick below with a big shop window, its shelves and counter inside, a timber-framed white floor above with a flower box, a dark red roof and a chimney; outside a bench, a lamp post, a bicycle and a customer. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A friendly maintenance robot
author: Brickworks
about: A small robot in white and orange on two tank tracks, with a domed head and big round eyes on a neck that turns, an antenna, a chest panel of lights, arms on joints ending in a claw and a spanner, and a toolbox on its back. Its head looks around as a motion in the app. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A narrow-gauge tank engine and coach
author: Brickworks
about: A little steam tank engine in black and dark red, with a tall chimney, a gold dome, side tanks and red wheels on connecting rods, its driver in the cab; behind it an open green coach with bench seats and a passenger, on its own length of track. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A pagoda in a garden
author: Brickworks
about: A three-tier pagoda in dark red and white with dark grey roofs that sweep up at the corners and a gold spire, on a stone base with steps, in a garden with a blossoming cherry tree, a stone lantern, a pond with lily pads and a little red bridge, and a monk. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A little dragon asleep on its hoard
author: Brickworks
about: A small green dragon asleep on a heap of gold: its head rests at the front with one eye open and its teeth showing, its folded wings and spined back rise over the hoard, and its tail curls round to the front. A goblet, gems, coins and a treasure chest lie on a dark grey cave floor. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A lakeside campsite
author: Brickworks
about: A minifigure camping scene: a green dome tent with its door open, a campfire ringed with stones and a cooking pot, log seats, a canoe pulled up on the sandy shore of a little lake with a fish, a tall pine and a signpost, and three campers, one toasting a marshmallow and one fishing. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.

name: A little potted cactus
author: Brickworks
about: A first build of 37 pieces in 11 steps: a round green cactus with two arms, banded in dark green, a pink flower on top and white tufts, in a reddish brown pot on a dark orange saucer. Designed with the assistant (Claude, in Brickworks) and finished by hand.
